verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA wange nkuwadde
-Omwoyo gwange gwonna;
Nnemenga okukuvaako
emirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Neesudde ku bigere byo,
Ggwe-eyakomererwa:
Komerera-ebibi byange,
Nkuweereze wekka.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Olw'ekisa kyo-ontukuze ,
Onfuule owuwo,
Ndyoke ndabe amaaso go
Nkutenderezenga.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Nkuwadde byonna bye nkola
N'ebyo bye ndowooza,
Nkuweereze mu bulamu,
Mu kufa nbe naawe.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Eddungu weeriri,
Lye mpitamu,naye
Ka nnyanguwe gy'oli
Ennyonta yange-eggwe.
